video.title: Mesopotamia Song | Grade 3 History for Kids | Little Takhti
video.description:
Sing along with Takhti and travel back to Mesopotamia, the land between the rivers! Kids learn about the Tigris and Euphrates, some of the first cities built with mud bricks, cuneiform writing pressed into clay tablets, the wheel, the plough and the ziggurat. Then shout the answers in the quiz!

Free Mesopotamia worksheets, quiz and games for grown-ups to print: littletakhti.com (tap the website link on the Little Takhti channel page)

Chapters
0:00 The song
0:12 Land between the rivers
0:29 Sing along
0:45 Cuneiform writing
1:22 Mesopotamia and the Indus Valley
1:34 Quiz
2:47 Sing along
